Questions teams ask us.

Can't find what you need? Explore the full FAQ page for more answers.

View all FAQs
What is RuleProof?

RuleProof is an AI-powered platform that orchestrates your regulatory flow, handles time-consuming tasks, incorporates human oversight, monitors performance and helps produce evidence at each step.

Is RuleProof a GRC platform?

RuleProof covers the work that connects requirements, policies, controls, testing, evidence requirements, and learning.

It is designed to help teams understand how the parts of a compliance programme fit together, rather than only store documents or display a status.

Is RuleProof tied to one framework?

No. RuleProof is designed around your regulations, standards, policies, controls, tests, and business context.

You are not required to force your programme into one fixed framework structure.

Can RuleProof help us create policies and controls?

RuleProof can help identify what needs to change, what is missing, and what needs to be drafted based on the obligations you are addressing.

Your team reviews and approves the result. The product should not be treated as a substitute for organisational judgement or subject matter expertise.

Can training be used on its own?

Yes.

Learning can be connected to Proof or used independently for compliance training, onboarding, role-based learning, and broader skills development.
